title: Vertex Claude request fields must live on the adapter, not the provider hook
answers: Vertex AI Claude judge fails with anthropic_version Field required
mlflow.genai judge vertex_ai claude-* SCORER_ERROR with empty value
Claude on Vertex AI gateway request rejected missing anthropic_version
Why does _prepare_payload not run for Vertex Claude judges
body:
Symptom: mlflow.genai judges using vertex_ai:/claude-* fail with "anthropic_version: Field required"; the scorer shows SCORER_ERROR with value=None while evaluate() still completes.
Root cause: mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py:_VertexAIClaudeProvider._prepare_payload was the only place adding anthropic_version and dropping model. It runs only from AnthropicProvider._chat/_chat_stream, but the judge path (mlflow/genai/judges/adapters/gateway_adapter.py) formats via adapter_class.chat_to_model and posts directly, skipping it.
Fix pattern: put the Vertex transformation in a classmethod on the adapter (_VertexAIClaudeAdapter(AnthropicAdapter)), override chat_to_model to call it after super(), and return that adapter from the adapter_class property on _VertexAIClaudeProvider. Keep _prepare_payload delegating to the same classmethod so the _chat path is unchanged.
Constraints: Applies to any Vertex Claude request built through adapter_class. Bedrock does the same thing in chat_to_model (AmazonBedrockAnthropicAdapter), so Vertex should match that layer.
applies: Any change to Claude-on-Vertex request formatting, or any new code path that builds a request from adapter_class instead of the provider.
says: Model evaluations using Claude on Vertex AI as a judge fail with scorer errors.
The evaluation report shows empty scorer results even though the evaluation run completes.
Automated LLM judges fail because Vertex Claude requests miss required API version parameters.
Support using Claude endpoints on Vertex AI for automated model evaluation scoring.
search: Claude-on-Vertex request formatting transformations must reside on _VertexAIClaudeAdapter rather than exclusively in _VertexAIClaudeProvider._prepare_payload. When mlflow.genai judges use vertex_ai:/claude-*, requests format via adapter_class.chat_to_model and bypass _prepare_payload, failing with anthropic_version Field required. The fix defines a classmethod on _VertexAIClaudeAdapter, overrides chat_to_model to invoke it, and has _prepare_payload delegate to the same adapter classmethod. Applies to any Claude request formatted through adapter_class, matching the architectural pattern used by AmazonBedrockAnthropicAdapter.
